name: Summit Ridge Credit Union
impact: Digital banking platform with transaction simulation and structured financial dashboards.
description: Developed a responsive banking platform with account dashboards, transaction flows, and structured financial data handling for simulated credit operations.
problem: Financial institutions require clean digital interfaces to manage user accounts, display transaction records, and simulate banking operations securely.
solution: Built a full stack system with structured database models, secure routing, responsive UI, and financial data rendering optimized for clarity and speed.
architecture: React SPA frontend, Node.js and Express REST API backend, PostgreSQL relational database, deployed production frontend and backend services.
technicalDecisions: PostgreSQL chosen for relational financial integrity. REST architecture for scalable API structure.

name: Campus Hub
impact: Real-time campus messaging platform with persistent chat storage.
description: Engineered backend architecture for a real-time chat system supporting instant communication, socket event handling, and persistent data storage.
problem: Students required low-latency communication infrastructure for campus-wide interactions.
solution: Implemented WebSocket-based messaging backend with event broadcasting and database persistence.
architecture: Node.js with Express server, Socket.io for bidirectional communication, PostgreSQL for message storage, deployed backend services.
technicalDecisions: Used Socket.io instead of polling to reduce latency. PostgreSQL for structured relational message storage.

name: Campus Hangout Backend
impact: Scalable backend service powering campus social interactions.
description: Built RESTful backend services to manage authentication, data routing, and structured API endpoints for a campus social platform.
problem: Frontend applications required a structured backend with clear API contracts and scalable hosting.
solution: Developed modular Express API with database integration and deployed it to cloud infrastructure.
architecture: Express server with modular routing, PostgreSQL database schema, deployed on Render cloud platform.
technicalDecisions: Modular route structure for scalability. Render selected for simplified deployment pipeline.

name: Zenus Bank
impact: Corporate banking interface with structured UI components and service pages.
description: Developed a responsive financial services interface showcasing structured banking products, landing flows, and corporate branding.
problem: Banking products required modern digital presentation with responsive adaptability.
solution: Created component-based React interface optimized for layout consistency and cross-device compatibility.
architecture: React frontend SPA with structured routing and reusable UI components.
technicalDecisions: Focused on reusable component architecture to ensure scalable UI structure.

name: Service Now Business Platform
impact: Business marketing website built with modern React architecture.
description: Designed and developed a responsive React-based business website focusing on clean layout, service presentation, and structured content delivery.
problem: Business required modern web presence with responsive UI and optimized structure.
solution: Implemented React-based UI system with reusable sections and optimized layout rendering.
architecture: React SPA with structured component system and production build optimization.
technicalDecisions: Prioritized responsive grid structure and performance optimization.

name: MK Signature Shop
impact: Online commerce platform with structured product listing and checkout flow.
description: Built an e-commerce platform featuring product display, shopping flow, and integrated payment handling.
problem: Retail products required digital storefront with secure checkout process.
solution: Engineered structured product system with responsive interface and payment processing flow.
architecture: React frontend with Node.js backend, API routing for product handling, integrated payment logic.
technicalDecisions: Separated product logic from UI for maintainability and scalable product updates.
